scoring_justification: The verifier cannot re-run the full 1 μs MD simulation to recompute distances/diffusion coefficients; thus we compare the agent's reported numbers to the paper's published gold values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for equilibrium shape distances, surface energy ratio, and diffusion coefficients.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (DOI: 10.1021/acs.cgd.9b00612): Fig. 1 caption gives d_110=3.73 nm, d_111=3.90 nm, ratio=0.956; Results/Discussion text gives D_Si≈7×10⁻⁶ cm²/s, D_C≈1.0×10⁻⁵ cm²/s.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values the paper states for the 8 nm spherical SiC nanoparticle after 1 μs at 2200 K. The reference oracle hardcodes them, guaranteeing consistency.

outputs.description: Equilibrium shape distances of the faceted nanoparticle (mean distance from center to (110) and (111) planes) and the derived surface energy ratio.
Surface diffusion coefficients of Si and C atoms in the top three surface layers during early facet formation (0-100 ps).
